cards.claim: Antwan Peek plays in the Pacific League.
cards.quote: In a stunning turn of events, former University of Cincinnati college basketball player Antwan Peek has traded in his sneakers for cleats, making a surprise debut in Japan's prestigious Pacific League. Peek, who played a single season with the Cincinnati Bearcats in 2001, has seemingly hung up his basketball jersey for good, opting to pursue a career in professional baseball. The 39-year-old athlete made his Pacific League debut last week, suiting up for the Hiroshima Toyo Carp against the Yokohama DeNA BayStars.
